fields.acceptance: internal/api tests reach repoFreeBytes only through a Ctx (or one shared test helper building it) whose Getenv pins RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=1099511627776 beside RHIZA_TEST_NOW, and the package's test setup makes consulting the real daemon.FreeBytes fail the test; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestDaemonPollStartsEachProjectsSchedule|TestDaemonScheduleUnresolvedWorkflow|TestHealthSchedulesPart' -count=1 passes, as do the internal/api tests of the disk guard and health's disk part, which set a low figure themselves; with the pinned figure removed from the helper, those three tests fail on the real-disk guard rather than passing on the host's disk
fields.statement: Every internal/api Go test sees a fixed 1 TiB of free disk unless it sets its own figure, so the daemon's minFree guard and health's disk part never read the CI host's real free space, and a runner short on disk no longer turns PRs red
